study_note: Two fresh seed-55 AMBI Dog Stand runs with MRS.Q-style critic aggregation: min over all critics for inner/outer TD targets and inner terminal bootstrap, mean over all critics for inner/outer actors. Compare five versus ten distributional critics; no pair sampling. Preserve the sampled post-tanh baseline, 1M decisions, H3/J8/K1, N128/C16/A4/B256, fixed joint entropy 0.0021, action-local adaptive scaling, all 25k checkpoints and critic geometry every 1k updates. This transfers the aggregation rules, not the entire MRS.Q algorithm.
